rewrite: Yth. Tim Rekrutmen Yayasan Pendidikan Pelangi Timur, saya melamar posisi Guru Informatika tingkat SMP. Saya pendidik yang menyukai teknologi dan percaya pendidikan membuka potensi generasi muda. Sudah 3 tahun saya mengajar di SMP Swasta Tunas Mekar, Kendari, dengan 186 siswa binaan setiap tahun ajaran. Pada 2024 saya merintis klub robotika sekolah, yang kemudian meraih juara 2 pada Kompetisi Robotika Pelajar Sultra. Menurut catatan sekolah, keikutsertaan di lomba itu menaikkan jumlah pendaftar peminatan informatika dari 24 menjadi 58 siswa. Sertifikat pendidik saya terbit pada 5 Mei 2023. Sesuai syarat "bersedia ditempatkan di kampus cabang Baubau", saya siap pindah domisili. Saya disiplin, kreatif, dan berorientasi pada hasil. Saya berharap dapat berdiskusi lebih lanjut dalam wawancara. Terima kasih atas waktu dan kesempatannya. Salam hormat, Maria Goreti Sampe.

Presensi-QR mengubah cara absensi di kampus. Tim mahasiswa Laboratorium Rekayasa Perangkat Lunak Universitas Samudra Jaya mengembangkannya sejak Februari 2026. Aplikasi ini membuat kode QR dinamis yang berganti setiap 30 detik untuk mencegah titip absen. Karena kodenya cepat berganti, foto kode QR yang dibagikan lewat grup obrolan sudah kedaluwarsa sebelum sempat dipindai. Backend memakai Node.js versi 20 dan basis data PostgreSQL 16. Uji coba di 4 kelas dengan 163 mahasiswa menurunkan waktu presensi dari 7 menit menjadi 50 detik per sesi. Untuk menjalankan: salin .env.example menjadi .env, lalu jalankan npm install dan npm run dev. Perhatikan: "variabel QR_SECRET wajib diisi minimal 32 karakter" agar server bisa berjalan. Kami menerima kontribusi agar proyek ini makin kokoh dan berkelanjutan. Lisensi: MIT.

Pantau-Sungai adalah proyek sumber terbuka untuk memantau ketinggian air sungai secara real-time, andal, dan murah. Proyek ini lahir dari kolaborasi Komunitas Maker Sungai Jeneberang Lestari dan Karang Taruna Desa Bontosunggu Indah pada Juni 2026. Sensor ultrasonik JSN-SR04T terpasang pada mikrokontroler ESP32 dan membaca setiap 60 detik. Data dikirim ke server lewat jaringan LoRa sejauh maksimal 3 kilometer, sehingga desa tanpa sinyal seluler tetap terpantau. Jika air melewati ambang 2,5 meter, sistem mengirim peringatan otomatis ke grup Telegram warga. Pada banjir 18 Agustus 2026, peringatan dini ini memberi tambahan waktu evakuasi sekitar 40 menit. Untuk instalasi, ikuti panduan di folder docs dan kompilasi firmware dengan PlatformIO. Aturan kami: "setiap pull request wajib menyertakan hasil uji di perangkat nyata". Dokumentasi ini akan terus diperbarui. Ayo berkontribusi agar desa lebih tangguh menghadapi bencana.

Notulen Rapat Koordinasi Panitia Dies Natalis ke-25 Universitas Mentari Pagi. Rapat berlangsung Jumat, 18 September 2026, pukul 13.30 WITA di Ruang Senat Gedung Rektorat. Ketua panitia, Bapak Dr. Frans Tandiarrang, membuka rapat dengan ucapan syukur atas kehadiran peserta. Hadir 22 dari 26 anggota panitia. Bendahara melaporkan dana terkumpul baru Rp 74 juta dari target Rp 120 juta. Dana kurang karena dua sponsor utama menunda pencairan sampai proposal revisi diterima. Seksi acara mengusulkan puncak perayaan tetap pada 14 November 2026 di Lapangan Utama kampus. Setelah diskusi, rapat memutuskan "proposal revisi dikirim ke sponsor paling lambat 25 September 2026". Seksi publikasi diminta menyiapkan materi promosi yang menarik. Rapat ditutup pukul 15.10 WITA dengan doa bersama. Rapat berjalan lancar.

Notulen Rapat Evaluasi Bulanan Divisi Layanan Pelanggan PT Jaringan Nusa Raya, Senin 21 September 2026. Rapat dipimpin Ibu Siska Maharani, kepala divisi, dan dihadiri 14 orang staf. Peserta membahas kualitas layanan. Pada Agustus, tiket keluhan naik 22 persen dari bulan sebelumnya menjadi 3.870. Lonjakan itu sebagian besar disebabkan oleh gangguan jaringan fiber selama tiga hari di wilayah Maros Utara. Rata-rata waktu penyelesaian tiket memburuk dari 18 jam menjadi 31 jam, sehingga skor kepuasan pelanggan turun ke 3,6. Ibu Siska menegaskan: "setiap tiket prioritas tinggi harus direspons dalam 2 jam". Tim sepakat menambah 4 agen di shift malam mulai 1 Oktober 2026. Seluruh agen juga akan mengikuti pelatihan penyegaran pada minggu kedua Oktober. Rapat berakhir pukul 11.45 dengan komitmen untuk terus memperbaiki pelayanan.

Information systems matter more and more in public health. Many community health centers still struggle to keep accurate immunization records. Puskesmas Harapan Kita in Maros Regency serves roughly 38,000 residents and records every vaccination on paper cards kept by parents. When a card is lost, nurses have no reliable way to confirm which doses a child has already received. A 2025 internal audit found that 1,140 children, about 14 percent of those under five, had incomplete or missing records. Because of these gaps, the center gave duplicate doses in 37 cases that year. Fixing this therefore needs an approach that holds up over time. The head of the center requires that any new system "work on the existing four desktop computers without new hardware purchases." So this study proposes a web-based immunization registry with SMS reminders for parents. The research aims to improve child health outcomes in the region.

Small-scale fisheries sustain coastal economies across Indonesia. However, fishers in many villages still struggle to get fair market prices. In Tanjung Bira Selatan, a fishing village of 260 households, catches go almost entirely to three middlemen who set prices each morning. Interviews held between 5 and 19 January 2026 showed that fishers receive on average 42 percent of the final retail price of red snapper. The imbalance arises largely because fishers have no real-time information on prices at the Paotere Baru fish auction, 180 kilometers away. As a result, household incomes fell by roughly Rp 600,000 per month during the 2025 lean season. The village cooperative, Nelayan Bersatu, has stated that any solution "must be usable by fishers who only own basic feature phones." The question is how a simple price-broadcast service could shift bargaining power. This study therefore designs and evaluates an SMS-based price information system built for local needs. The aim is a practical intervention that can scale and include coastal communities.

The author interned at Lumina Cloud Solutions, a software firm headquartered on Jalan Pettarani, Makassar, from 3 June to 26 August 2026. The author worked on the quality assurance team under Ms. Clara Sutanto. The team tested a mobile banking application used by approximately 95,000 customers of Bank Sejahtera Mandala. A main task was writing automated test scripts in Appium, which eventually covered 212 test cases. Before automation, a full regression cycle took the team 5 working days, which often delayed releases. With the scripts, the same cycle took about 6 hours, so the team could release weekly instead of monthly. The supervisor set a rule: "no build ships unless every critical test passes twice in a row." The internship gave the author insight into professional software development and was a rewarding learning experience.

The internship links academic theory with professional practice. The author completed a ten-week placement in the customer data division of the Regional Water Utility of Kota Sungai Biru. It began on 14 July 2026 under Mr. Arief Nugraha, the division's head of information systems. At the start, the utility kept billing data for 48,300 household connections in a legacy spreadsheet system. Duplicate customer entries in that system caused 1,900 households to receive two bills in May 2026, which set off a wave of complaints. The author's task was to find and merge these duplicates while keeping each customer's payment history. Using Python scripts and manual checks, the author cleaned 3,412 records over six weeks. Management insisted that "no record may be deleted, only merged and flagged." That rule shaped every step of the cleaning workflow. The internship let the author build technical, analytical, and communication skills in a supportive team.

This study examines whether gamification improves student engagement in online programming courses. Massive open online courses have grown popular, yet their completion rates stay low. The research ran at Nusantara Open Academy over a 12-week term starting in February 2026, with 486 learners. Participants were split into a control group and an experimental group that received badges, streaks, and a weekly leaderboard. The experimental group completed the course at 63 percent, against 29 percent in the control group. Activity logs suggest the gain came mainly from streak reminders, which cut the average gap between study sessions from 5.1 days to 2.3 days. The leaderboard had no measurable effect on quiz scores. The findings matter for instructional designers who want learners to keep participating. Gamification, when implemented carefully, can improve online learning outcomes. Keywords: gamification, online learning, engagement, completion rate.
